title: NFR-008 unknown outcome: no blind resend, reconciliation is mandatory
risk: A timeout with an unknown external outcome triggers an immediate resend, so the customer receives two orders or two messages and finance sees one of them.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.
The mock adapter is scripted to accept the request, drop the response, and record that the effect actually happened.

steps.action: Dispatch the action and observe the dropped response
steps.expected: The execution is recorded as unknown or failed with the transport error preserved; the caller is not told it succeeded.
The retry is gated on reconciliation: the platform queries the provider receipt for the effect_key before sending anything.

steps.action: Complete reconciliation with the provider receipt
steps.expected: The provider confirms the effect occurred; the execution resolves to success with exactly one external effect.
One effect, one receipt, two attempts; no second message is created.

assertions: An unknown outcome never results in a second external effect: exactly one effect across both attempts.
The interim record does not claim success before reconciliation completes.
The transport error is preserved so the incident is diagnosable.
Reconciliation resolves the execution to a terminal state with a receipt reference.
forbidden: Resending immediately without checking the provider.
Declaring failure and giving up, leaving the customer with no confirmation either way.
Counting the unknown attempt as a duplicate execution in the KPI.
evidence: Both attempt records with transport errors and the reconciliation result.
Provider receipt for the single effect.
Final execution state and reconciliation log.
cleanup: Delete gov- execution rows; the single simulated send is reported as non-recallable.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
